description: This is a Java source file defining the class JmsBasedTenantClient, which implements a client for interacting with a Tenant service over JMS using the Eclipse Hono framework. It contains methods for creating a client instance, retrieving tenant information by tenant ID or subject DN, and handling request/response messaging with the JMS API.

classes.name: JmsBasedTenantClient
classes.description: A client class that interacts with the Tenant service via JMS, providing asynchronous methods to retrieve tenant information.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of JmsBasedTenantClient and initialize links.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve tenant information either by tenant ID, subject DN, or search criteria.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JMS request with specified operation and search criteria, handling response and error cases.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload and status, handling JSON decoding and error conditions.
